name: invoice.ts
note: `as` asserts a shape and proves nothing, and `JSON.parse` gives `any` and may throw. A schema proves the shape, and both failures are in a `Result`.

name: share.ts
note: A `throw` is in no type. A function that may fail returns a `Result`, and who calls it cannot forget the failure.

name: catalog.ts
note: `null` and `!` are refused. What may be missing is an `Option`, and each use says what happens when it is.

name: cart.ts
note: Types are read-only unless they say `Mut<T>`. A function changes only what it made, or what its signature asks to change.

name: transfer.ts
note: A value typed `Once<T>` has one owner and is given away exactly once: left open on one path, it is refused.
